headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Insights
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk insights and binding.gyp command expansion checks to improve ClearInstall's local-first lockfile auditing. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analysis of potential vulnerabilities.
